item.text:
Documented that both primary recovery defects also affect the package-level `GetConfiguration` helper:

- It inherits the lost-configuration behavior because it uses the same `NewRaft` path.
- With `skipStartup=true`, it has no FSM consumer at all, so sufficiently large committed suffixes can deadlock there as well.

This is now recorded in [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_09-39-48-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md).
